verdict.rationale: mise stores all configuration (tools, env vars, tasks) as plain-text mise.toml/.tool-versions/.env files checked into the user's own repo rather than in a proprietary store, and is explicitly designed to be replaced by a single checked-in file (mise-docs-19, mise-docs-48, mise-docs-7). This gives inherent openness/portability, but there is no explicit 'export my data' feature, no documented data-export command, and no discussion of migrating away from mise once adopted. Missing for 10: an explicit export/migration command or docs, evidence of leaving mise without losing configuration state (e.g. tool version history, lockfile portability guarantees).
